mapper.select: SELECT c.campaignid AS campaignId, g.gid AS adgroupId FROM h3_naver_adgroup g LEFT JOIN h3_naver_campaign c ON c.campaignid = g.cid WHERE g.advkey = #{customerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO h3_adgroup_daily_naver ( user_id, daily_advid, daily_dt, campaign_id, adgroup_id, daily_im, daily_clk, daily_cst, daily_cv, daily_cr ) VALUES ( NULL, #{daily_advid}, #{daily_dt}, #{campaign_id}, #{adgroup_id}, #{daily_im}, #{daily_clk}, #{daily_cst}, #{daily_cv}, #{daily_cr} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE daily_im = VALUES(daily_im), daily_clk = VALUES(daily_clk), daily_cst = VALUES(daily_cst), daily_cv = VALUES(daily_cv), daily_cr = VALUES(daily_cr), daily_regdate = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
